title: Custom building specification
description: Input specification for OpenstudioStandards::CreateTypical.create_custom_building_from_spec. Defines a custom building type as a named mix of standard space types with custom area ratios, building form, schedule overrides, and internal load overrides. Building, space type, template, and climate zone names are validated against live standards data at runtime, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema file, enables editor autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Label for the custom building. Sets the Building object name and a 'custom_building_type' additional property. Does not affect standards lookups.

template.description: OpenStudio Standards template, e.g. '90.1-2013'. Must be resolvable by Standard.build (checked at runtime).

climate_zone.description: ASHRAE or CEC climate zone, e.g. 'ASHRAE 169-2013-4A'.

primary_building_type.description: Standard building type that drives building form defaults, the default construction set, residential classification, internal mass, and prototype HVAC assumptions. Must be a standard building type (checked at runtime). When omitted, the building type of the first ratio entry drives the form and the largest space type floor area drives the rest.

space_type_ratios.description: Space types making up the building and their fractions of total floor area. Ratios should sum to 1.0 (checked at runtime).

schedule_overrides.description: Runtime parametric schedule overrides, applied field-by-field over the standard parametric schedule parameters. Only used with schedule_method 'parametric' (the default).

load_overrides.description: Runtime internal load overrides, applied on top of the loads created from standards space type data.

typical_options.description: Additional keyword arguments passed through to create_typical_building_from_model, e.g. {"add_hvac": false, "schedule_method": "parametric"}. Keys are validated at runtime against the method signature. climate_zone, primary_building_type, building_name, schedule_overrides, and load_overrides are managed by the top-level spec keys and are not allowed here.

building_type.description: Standard building type the space type is drawn from, e.g. 'MediumOffice'. Checked against standards data for the template at runtime.

space_type.description: Standard space type within the building type, e.g. 'Conference'. Checked against standards data for the template at runtime.

ratio.description: Fraction of total building floor area for this space type. All ratios should sum to 1.0.

story_height.description: Custom story height for this space type in ft. Creates a custom-height bar section when the building floor height is left to its smart default.

wwr.description: Window to wall ratio for this space type's exterior walls. Only used when the building-level wwr resolves to 0 (e.g. Warehouse form defaults).

default.description: Marks this space type as the default (perimeter) space type for double-loaded corridor placement. Exactly one default and one circ entry per building type enables the double-loaded corridor.

circ.description: Marks this space type as the circulation space type for double-loaded corridor placement.

space_type_gen.description: When false, the space type is created but no geometry is generated for it (used for undeveloped or basement space types).

position.description: Plan position for the 'Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced' division method. 'perimeter' places the space type along the facades with exterior walls and windows, 'core' places it in the interior with no exterior exposure, and 'any' lets the layout decide by size. Overrides the automatic name/size heuristics.

orientation.description: Preferred facades for a perimeter-positioned space type, used by the 'Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced' division method. A preference, not a guarantee: overflow continues onto adjacent facades.

form.description: Building form arguments passed through to the bar geometry generator. All values are optional; a value of 0 (the default) means 'use the smart default for the primary building type'.

total_bldg_floor_area.description: Total building floor area in ft^2. Defaults to 10000.

single_floor_area.description: Single floor area in ft^2. When greater than 0, overrides total_bldg_floor_area and disables custom-height bars.

num_stories_above_grade.description: Number of stories above grade. Defaults to 1.

num_stories_below_grade.description: Number of stories below grade. Defaults to 0.

floor_height.description: Typical floor-to-floor height in ft. 0 uses the smart default for the primary building type.

custom_height_bar.description: When true (default), space types with a story_height get a dedicated custom-height bar section.

building_rotation.description: Building rotation in degrees from north.

ns_to_ew_ratio.description: North-south to east-west aspect ratio. 0 uses the smart default for the primary building type.

perim_mult.description: Perimeter multiplier. 0 uses the smart default; other values must be >= 1.0.

bar_width.description: Bar width in ft. Non-zero values override the perimeter multiplier.

bar_sep_dist_mult.description: Bar separation distance multiplier for dual-bar buildings. Defaults to 10.

wwr.description: Building window to wall ratio. 0 uses the smart default for the primary building type.

party_wall_fraction.description: Fraction of exterior wall area with an adjacent structure.

party_wall_stories_north.description: Number of stories with party walls on the north facade.

party_wall_stories_south.description: Number of stories with party walls on the south facade.

party_wall_stories_east.description: Number of stories with party walls on the east facade.

party_wall_stories_west.description: Number of stories with party walls on the west facade.

bottom_story_ground_exposed_floor.description: When true (default), the bottom story floor is ground exposed.

top_story_exterior_exposed_roof.description: When true (default), the top story roof is exterior exposed.

story_multiplier_method.description: Story multiplier method. Defaults to 'Basements Ground Mid Top'.

make_mid_story_surfaces_adiabatic.description: When true (default), mid-story floor/ceiling surfaces are adiabatic instead of intersected and matched.

enum: Multiple Space Types - Individual Stories Sliced
Single Space Type - Core and Perimeter
Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced
bar_division_method.description: How the bar is divided into spaces. Defaults to 'Multiple Space Types - Individual Stories Sliced'. 'Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced' positions perimeter-classified space types along the facades and core-classified space types in the interior (see the space_type_ratios position and orientation keys and the perimeter_* form keys).

perimeter_zone_depth.description: Target perimeter zone depth in ft for the 'Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced' division method, used when there are no core space types. Defaults to 15.

perimeter_depth_min.description: Minimum perimeter zone depth in ft for the perimeter and core division method. Defaults to 8.

perimeter_depth_max.description: Maximum perimeter zone depth in ft for the perimeter and core division method. Defaults to 25.

position_size_threshold.description: Fraction of building floor area below which an unclassified space type is biased toward the core (larger types toward the perimeter). Defaults to 0.05.

zoning_method.description: How spaces are grouped into thermal zones. 'Individual Spaces' (default) makes one zone per space. 'Perimeter Orientation and Core' makes one zone per facade plus a combined core zone per story, with load-distinct types (mechanical, electrical, kitchen, etc.) zoned individually. 'Space Type Groups' groups by the zone_groups key.

zone_groups.description: Custom thermal zone groups for the 'Space Type Groups' zoning method.

zone_group_default.description: How spaces unmatched by any zone_groups entry are zoned. 'heuristic' applies the 'Perimeter Orientation and Core' grouping; 'individual' gives each unmatched space its own zone. Defaults to 'heuristic'.

double_loaded_corridor.description: Double-loaded corridor placement. Defaults to 'Primary Space Type', which sandwiches a circ-flagged space type between default-flagged space types. Ignored by the 'Multiple Space Types - Perimeter and Core Sliced' division method.

space_type_sort_logic.description: Order in which space types are laid out along the bar. Defaults to 'Building Type > Size'.

building_form_defaults.description: Form default values that override the built-in lookup for the primary building type. Required when primary_building_type is not a standard building type and the corresponding form arguments are left at 0.

aspect_ratio.description: Default north-south to east-west aspect ratio.

typical_story.description: Default typical story height in ft.

first_story.description: Default first story height in ft, for building types with a taller ground floor.

zone_group_entry.description: A custom thermal zone group for the 'Space Type Groups' zoning method.

name.description: Zone name stem for the group, e.g. 'core support'. Zone names become 'Zone <story> <name>'.

space_types.description: Space types in the group, as 'BuildingType|SpaceType' keys (a bare space type name matches across building types).

zone_per.description: Zone granularity: 'group' (one zone per story for the whole group), 'space' (one zone per space), 'facade' (one zone per facade run per story, perimeter types only), or 'space_type' (one zone per space type per story). Defaults to 'group'.

position.description: Optional filter that only matches spaces that landed in the given band, e.g. group core corridors while perimeter corridor overflow zones with its facade.

space_type.description: Match key: a schedule set name, a standards space type (e.g. 'conference/meeting/multipurpose'), or '*' for all space types.

schedule_set.description: Match key: a parametric schedule set name.

standards_space_type.description: Match key: a standards space type name.

schedule_override_section.description: Parametric schedule parameter overrides for one load. Common fields are base and peak (schedule fraction values); any parametric expansion or derivation parameter accepted by the schedules module may be supplied.

space_type.description: Match key: a schedule set name, a standards space type (e.g. 'classroom/lecture/training'), or '*' for all space types.

schedule_set.description: Match key: a parametric schedule set name.

standards_space_type.description: Match key: a standards space type name.

people_per_1000_ft2.description: Occupant density in people per 1000 ft^2.

w_per_area.description: Electric equipment power density in W/ft^2.

btu_per_hr_per_area.description: Gas equipment power density in Btu/hr per ft^2.

cfm_per_person.description: Outdoor air flow per person in cfm.

cfm_per_area.description: Outdoor air flow per floor area in cfm/ft^2.

ach.description: Outdoor air flow in air changes per hour.
